answer.rationale: Use the confirmed shortened-onboarding approach for self-serve SMB acquisition rather than matching the competitor’s price cut. Shortened onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, adoption, and 30-day retention, while SMB signup simplification improved qualified revenue but showed a small retention decline. Run a standard, retention-guarded SMB deployment focused on shortening time-to-value; do not broadly use promotional pricing because prior evidence shows material 30-day retention harm despite acquisition lift.
